Andre Kumar: Heads-up — PR #8427 should not be merged until we attach the architecture RFC and get arch signoff. I can add the RFC link but need a merge window (we're trying to land before next deploy).
Vijay Patel: Ack. Can you paste the RFC link here + 2–3 bullets on risk/perf impact? I can't review blind.
Andre Kumar: RFC: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/2026/prefix-caching-8427.md
Andre Kumar: Quick bullets: 1) adds per-tenant prefix KV caching + fallback; 2) targets 30% token cost reduction for chat workloads; 3) requires a lightweight migration (no downtime) — see migration.md in RFC.
Lisa Chen: Does the new cache change shard affinity or leader elections? that could affect SLOs.
Andre Kumar: No leader changes. Shard affinity unchanged. Migration adds a short background warmup job per shard (staggered). We measured p95 latency delta ~+40ms during warmup on test infra; steady-state latency unchanged.
Vijay Patel: Need a short design summary in PR description (1–2 paras) calling out warmup behavior and fallback path. Also add the perf graphs (p95/p50) from the RFC as attachments.
Andre Kumar: Will update PR now.
Carol Nguyen: release-bot: please note — last release slot for this week is Thursday 09:00 UTC. If we want to merge earlier we need a pre-approval from Eng Leads.
Andre Kumar: Thx @Carol Nguyen — aiming for Wednesday EOD. I'll add the RFC pointer and test artifacts by EOD tomorrow.
Vijay Patel: I'll do a focused review once those are in. If the summary and graphs are present I can sign off tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Lisa Chen: tagging perf-qa — if you could run the warmup job sim on staging after Andre's changes, that'd be great.
Andre Kumar: Thanks — PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8427. Command I used for load: ```./scripts/run_load_test --profile=chat-warmup --duration=10m```
release-bot: Note added: PR 8427 is marked 'awaiting-arch' and will block merge without signoff.
Vijay Patel: Cool. Once PR has the RFC link + perf graphs + 1-paragraph design summary, I'll add ARCH LGTM.
Andre Kumar: Appreciated. I'll ping here when done. :wave:
